app.name: Grammarly: AI Keyboard & Notes
app.description: AI-powered writing assistant with keyboard integration, grammar checking, and document editing. Includes generative AI features and cloud-based document management.

verdict.one_liner: Strong privacy commitments but collects extensive data including everything you write for AI training.
verdict.summary: Grammarly offers strong privacy protections including a commitment to never sell your data and keeping user content out of advertising. However, the app collects extensive information including all text you write, device details, contacts, and uses this data to train AI models by default. While opt-outs exist, the breadth of data collection warrants caution.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Good for users who need writing assistance and are comfortable with AI processing their text. Best suited for professional/enterprise use where the productivity benefits outweigh privacy tradeoffs. Users should disable AI training in settings and avoid typing highly sensitive content.

red.title: AI training enabled by default
red.plain_english: Everything you write is used to train Grammarly's AI models unless you manually turn this off in settings. This includes emails, documents, and any text you type.

red.title: Collects contacts and data about non-users
red.plain_english: If you give Grammarly access to your contacts, it uploads this information. They also collect information about people you email who don't use Grammarly.

red.title: Extensive device and app tracking
red.plain_english: Grammarly collects detailed technical information about your device including what apps you have installed, browser plugins, IP address, and uses this to build a profile about you.

red.title: Data shared with advertising partners
red.plain_english: While your actual writing isn't shared, identifiers like your email and phone number are converted to unique codes and shared with ad networks to show you Grammarly ads on other websites.

green.title: Your writing is never sold or monetized
green.plain_english: Grammarly explicitly states they never rent or sell your user content. Your words stay yours and aren't used to make money through selling data.

green.title: AI training can be disabled
green.plain_english: You can turn off AI training in your account settings, preventing your content from being used to improve their models.

green.title: Strong data deletion and export options
green.plain_english: You can request to see, download, or delete your personal data. Grammarly provides clear ways to exercise your privacy rights.

green.title: Writing never used for advertising
green.plain_english: Grammarly promises they do not use the content you write for marketing or advertising purposes. Only technical data is used for ads.

green.title: Enterprise accounts have separate data handling
green.plain_english: If you use Grammarly through work or school, your employer controls the data policy, and Grammarly processes content according to your organization's rules.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Grammarly does not access your camera or microphone. The app works with text input only.
categories.detail: No camera or microphone access is mentioned in the privacy policy. The app functions entirely through text input.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Grammarly guesses your approximate location from your IP address to set your timezone, but doesn't use precise GPS tracking.
categories.detail: Technical information collected includes time zone setting and location inferred from IP address. This is used for service functionality, not continuous tracking.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect technical information about your device... including your IP address, device type... time zone setting and location...
concerns: Used for timezone and service optimization

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: If you allow access, Grammarly uploads your contacts to make spelling suggestions better. They also collect information about people you email who don't use Grammarly.
categories.detail: Contact access is optional but if granted, contact data is uploaded. Non-user data from emails is collected but only used to provide the service, not for marketing.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your user content may include information about others... if you choose to give our products access to your contacts so our editing products make appropriate spelling suggestions.
concerns: Non-user data could potentially be retained

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Grammarly needs access to files and documents you choose to edit. Cloud storage is used to sync your documents across devices.
categories.detail: User content including documents and files is uploaded for processing and cloud-based document management. Required for core functionality.
categories.policy_excerpt: User content: We receive the content you upload or enable our products to access, such as emails and drafts, text, documents, files...
concerns: All user content uploaded to cloud servers

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Your data is shared with service providers who help run Grammarly (like cloud storage and AI), but your actual writing is never sold or shared with advertisers.
categories.detail: Data shared with service providers (AI technology, cloud storage, payment processors), advertising partners (limited identifiers only, not content), and marketplace participants (only when user chooses integration). User content explicitly excluded from advertising use.
categories.policy_excerpt: We use trusted service providers to help power our products... We do not make user content available to these companies [advertising partners].
concerns: Multiple service providers have access to data

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You need an account with email, name, and potentially job information. Grammarly may infer things about you like your interests and writing style.
categories.detail: Account creation requires email, password, name. Optional info includes job titles, phone numbers. Single sign-on available. Inferences made about user interests, location, industry, and writing style.
categories.policy_excerpt: Account information: When you create an individual or organizational account, we collect information such as your email address, password, name, email preferences, job titles, and phone numbers.
concerns: Information from other sources combined with account data
Licensed data from third parties may be added

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Grammarly tracks what you click on their website and uses cookies to show you ads for Grammarly on other sites. You can opt out of this.
categories.detail: Cookies and similar technologies used to track website interactions. Email/phone converted to unique identifiers for targeted advertising on third-party sites. Opt-out available through privacy choices.
categories.policy_excerpt: We engage other companies to serve advertisements promoting our products... These companies may use Cookies to collect limited information about your interactions with our websites.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Grammarly says their service is for ages 13+, but there's no strong system in place to verify ages or protect children who might use it.
categories.detail: App rated 12+ on App Store. States not for under 13 but no strong enforcement mechanism mentioned. No specific children's safeguards described.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not engage in sales, sharing, or targeted advertising using personal information about anyone we know to be under the age of 18.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Grammarly logs basic information like your IP address for security and to keep the service running, which is standard practice.
categories.detail: Standard IP logging and security monitoring. Usage data about feature usage collected. No evidence of traffic interception or selling.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect usage data about how you interact with us and our products, including your activity on our websites and apps... security logs...
concerns: IP address logged and used for location inference

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Grammarly collects detailed information about your device including what apps you have installed, which could be used to identify you across different services.
categories.detail: Extensive technical data collected: device type, browser type/version, apps installed on device, browser plugin types/versions, operating system, platform, third-party apps where Grammarly is used.
categories.policy_excerpt: Technical information: We collect technical information about your device and how you access our products. This includes your IP address, device type, browser type and version, apps installed on your device...

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Grammarly doesn't collect any health or biometric information.
categories.detail: No health or biometric data collection mentioned. Authentication uses standard methods, not biometric data collection by Grammarly.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: When you pay, Grammarly uses third-party processors and doesn't store your credit card details themselves.
categories.detail: Payment processing handled by third-party processors. Grammarly receives transaction information but not direct card details.
categories.policy_excerpt: Payment information: If you make a purchase or payment with us, we collect information about the transaction, and our third-party payment processor will handle your payment information.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You have good control over your data. You can view, download, correct, or delete your information, and opt out of AI training and advertising.
categories.detail: Comprehensive rights: access, correction, deletion, export/portability, opt-out of AI training, opt-out of targeted advertising, cookie controls. Enterprise users must go through their organization.
categories.policy_excerpt: Depending on where you live, you may have rights under privacy laws to access, correct, or delete your personal data...
concerns: Enterprise users must contact their organization for rights requests

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Grammarly will email you about big privacy policy changes, but continued use of the app counts as accepting smaller updates.
categories.detail: Material changes get additional notice via email. Policy updated by publishing new version. Users notified of material changes.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time by publishing an updated version. If we make material changes, we will provide you additional notice, such as by sending you an email.
concerns: Non-material changes may not be prominently notified
